ftb.guhs_techniek.section.t2_centrale: Tier 2: The Old Guh Wheel Power Plant
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.tk_schakelaar.title: On, Off, On, Off
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.tk_schakelaar.desc: Put a &dChonk Switch&r in your wire: click it and everything behind it turns off or on. Your guh gets a little breather too (not that it wants one).
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.tk_kassier.title: The Greenhouse Picks Itself
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.tk_kassier.desc: Give a resident of your &dGuh House&r the chore &eGreenhouse keeper: picking the greenhouse&r. It walks into your Cheese Greenhouse, picks everything ripe and replants it right away. Seen it? Tick it off.
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.tk_sausslang.title: A Hose Full of Sauce
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.tk_sausslang.desc: Dried kelp, copper and a grill skewer give 8 &dSauce Hoses&r (no recipe card needed). They carry sauce from pump to vat and machine. Slurp!
